item.title: LVM snapshot-as-volume-chain: live VM snapshots lose PBS dirty bitmaps and force full disk scans
item.author: invalid@example.com (matraii)
item.dc:creator: matraii
item.content:encoded:
Summary​

Taking a manual snapshot of a running VM on shared LVM storage with
snapshot-as-volume-chain enabled causes the next PBS backup to report
"dirty-bitmap status: created new" and scan the entire virtual disk.

The VM is not stopped or started again during this workflow. This is not
the known loss of dirty bitmaps after a VM stop/start. The issue occurs
whether the manual snapshot is retained or subsequently deleted.
